memory_update.text: MIDD should remain the reference anchor for restaurant commercial foodservice equipment exposure in this node.
PNR is a useful underfollowed adjacent candidate because Everpure/Manitowoc map to water quality, ice, beverage consistency and equipment uptime rather than restaurant traffic.
COKE is a hidden service-network candidate for fountain/post-mix beverage equipment and foodservice route density, despite screening as a beverage bottler.
SERV belongs in the speculative shadow lane only; restaurant automation relevance is direct, but durability depends on verified unit economics, regulation and partner retention.

Farmer Bros. had strong coffee-equipment service relevance historically, but search evidence indicates FARM was acquired/delisted in May 2026; exclude from current US-listed candidate set unless a later listing status check contradicts this.

node: Kitchen equipment, beverage dispensing, refrigeration, service, and labor-saving automation
summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the restaurant equipment/service/automation node. The cleanest reference anchor is Middleby, because its disclosed Commercial Foodservice segment is directly tied to QSR/full-service restaurant equipment. The underfollowed lane is more interesting in adjacent chokepoints: Pentair as a water/ice/filtration component supplier for beverage, coffee, fountain, ice and kitchen equipment uptime; Coca-Cola Consolidated as a beverage-route and fountain-equipment service node that screens as a bottler rather than restaurant infrastructure; and Serve Robotics as a speculative labor-saving automation platform tied to food delivery economics. This is research support only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
